desc:
MADE WITH REAL HONEY: Sweetened whole grain oat cereal with real honey and natural almond flavor in every delicious spoonful; Whole grain oats are the first ingredient in this honey nut cereal for kids and adults; An ideal pantry staple

CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL as part of a heart healthy diet; 3g of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease; Honey Nut Cheerios provides .75g per serving

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour it in a bowl with cold milk for an irresistible, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some up in a lunch box for gluten free snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars and other kids snack food recipes

WHOLE GRAIN: 22g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and is a good source of calcium and fiber per serving

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Honey Nut Cheerios, Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, Mega Size, 27.2 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Key Features:

Made with Whole Grain Oats

Each serving contains 21 grams of whole grains, helping meet your daily nutritional goals.

Strawberry & Banana Flavor

Naturally flavored with real fruit purees for an authentic fruity taste.

Gluten-Free

Certified gluten-free, safe for those with gluten sensitivities or preferences.

No Artificial Colors or Flavors

Crafted with clean ingredients for a natural breakfast option.

Fortified with Essential Vitamins & Minerals

Includes 12 nutrients like iron, vitamin D, and calcium.

Benefits:

Supports Heart Health

Contains soluble fiber from oats, which may help lower cholesterol as part of a heart-healthy diet.

Nutritious Start to the Day

Provides fiber, whole grains, and essential vitamins for balanced energy.

Kid-Approved Taste

Sweet fruit flavor makes it appealing for children and adults alike.

Versatile Use

Enjoy it as a breakfast cereal, dry snack, or even as a base in cereal bars.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Starch, Honey, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Natural Almond Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
